name: Genuine Edge Probe — Orchestrator (activity-resolver: producer -> consumer)
description: The FIRST genuine capability->capability composition in the substrate. Dispatches two REAL sub-activities via the native 'activity' resolver (config.templateId): (1) genuine-edge-probe-producer (emits shape 'genuine_chain_signal' into the SHARED runtime store), then (2) genuine-edge-probe-consumer (declares inputShapes ['genuine_chain_signal'], so the engine's resolveInputs finds the producer's output in the shared store and the consumer child consumes it via shape-flow). The 'activity' resolver spawns each sub-activity as a child execution with parent_execution_id = this orchestrator's execution id, so the composition-edge reconciler derives two NON-HUB edges: orchestrator->producer and orchestrator->consumer. Neither endpoint is a lifecycle hub (slot-binding / validator-dispatch), so genuine_edges (the honest lambda_1) rises above 0. The producer->consumer link is a TRUE shape-flow dependency: the consumer task only resolves because the producer task already populated genuine_chain_signal into the shared pool. Uses the 'activity' resolver (not 'compose') because activity-api's TemplateTaskSchema strips the top-level subActivityId field but preserves config (z.record), so config.templateId survives the upload round-trip. No executor change.

tasks.description: Dispatch the producer sub-activity as a child execution. Its output (genuine_chain_signal) is emitted into the SHARED runtime store (nested executions keep their outputs live), making it findable by the next task's inputShapes resolution.

Dispatch the consumer sub-activity as a child execution. The consumer's own task declares inputShapes ['genuine_chain_signal'] and resolves it from the shared store (populated by the producer child above) — a real shape-flow dependency, not a coincidental sibling.
